en.name: Dry stuffing mix, packaged
en.summary: A commercially packaged box or packet of dry stuffing mix keeps 9–12 months in the cupboard. It should not be refrigerated. Once it has been made up with liquid it is no longer a dry good at all, and becomes a cooked dish on a few days' clock.
en.pantry: The cupboard is the right and only home for it: 9–12 months, cool, dry and dark, with the box away from the hob and the kettle. The mix is dried bread or cracker crumb with salt, fat and seasoning, and its whole preservation system is dryness — steam, a damp shelf or a sealed plastic tub that has trapped humidity will let it go stale and eventually mouldy long before the printed date. Once the inner bag is open, clip or reseal it hard; the crumb picks up moisture and kitchen smells within days.
en.fridge: Do not refrigerate it. A fridge is a damp place by design, and a paper-lined box of dry crumb sitting in it will soften and clump, which is the one thing that shortens its life. This is a quality and moisture instruction rather than a safety one. Made-up stuffing is a different food entirely: once you have added stock, butter or egg it is a cooked dish, and it must be cooled quickly and refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below rather than left in a warm oven or on the worktop.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for dry stuffing mix, and there is little point: a dry good that already keeps the best part of a year in a cupboard gains nothing from the freezer, and condensation on the way out is a real risk. If you have frozen a bulk buy anyway, let the sealed pack return to room temperature before you open it. Prepared, cooked stuffing does freeze, but treat that as a cooked dish rather than as this product.
spoilage: A stale, cardboard or rancid smell from the fat in the seasoning.
Crumb that has clumped or gone soft instead of rattling loose and dry.
Mould spots, usually where the bag has been open in a humid kitchen.
Weevils, webbing or fine dust at the bottom of the bag.
tips: Keep the inner bag clipped shut once opened; the box alone is not a seal.
Store on a high shelf rather than under the sink or beside the kettle.
Buy the size you will actually use; a family box outlives most households.
Once made up, cool it fast and refrigerate — it is then a cooked dish, not a pantry item.

faq.q: How long does boxed stuffing mix last?
faq.a: 9–12 months in a cool dry cupboard. Follow the printed date if it is shorter.
No. The fridge is humid and will make the crumb soften and clump. Keep it in a dry cupboard.

faq.q: Can you still use stuffing mix past the date?
faq.a: If it is dry, loose and smells clean it is usually fine, though the seasoning fades. Discard it if it smells rancid or has clumped or moulded.

zh.name: 乾燥填餡料
zh.summary: 市售盒裝或袋裝的乾燥填餡料，放櫥櫃可放 9～12 個月，而且不要冷藏。一旦加了液體拌開，它就不再是乾貨，而是一道只能放幾天的熟食。
zh.pantry: 櫥櫃是它唯一正確的位置：9～12 個月，陰涼、乾燥、避光，盒子要遠離爐台和熱水壺。這東西是乾燥的麵包丁或餅乾屑加鹽、油脂與香料，它的保存系統就是「乾」——蒸氣、潮濕的層架，或是一個把濕氣關在裡面的塑膠密封盒，都會讓它先走味、最後長霉，根本撐不到標示日期。內袋一開就要夾緊或確實封好，麵包屑幾天內就會吸走水氣和廚房的味道。
zh.fridge: 不要冷藏。冰箱的設計本來就是個潮濕的空間，一盒襯紙包裝的乾麵包屑放進去只會受潮結塊，而那正是唯一會縮短它壽命的事。這是水分與品質的指示，不是安全問題。拌好的填餡料則完全是另一種食物：一旦加了高湯、奶油或蛋，它就是一道熟食，必須快速降溫並冷藏在 4 °C 以下，而不是留在溫熱的烤箱或流理台上。
zh.freezer: 乾燥填餡料沒有公布的冷凍期限，也沒什麼意義：一個本來就能在櫥櫃放將近一年的乾貨，冷凍得不到什麼，拿出來時的結露反而是真正的風險。如果已經冷凍了一大包，請等整包回到室溫再拆開。拌好烤過的填餡料確實可以冷凍，但那要當成熟食來看，而不是當成這個產品。
spoilage: 有走味的紙板味，或香料中的油脂發出油耗味。
麵包屑結塊或變軟，而不是乾爽鬆散、倒出來會沙沙作響。
長霉，通常出現在潮濕廚房裡開過的袋子中。
有米蟲、絲網，或袋底出現細粉。
tips: 開封後內袋要夾起來，光靠外盒不算密封。
放在高處層架，不要放水槽下或熱水壺旁邊。
買你真的用得完的份量，家庭號往往放到過期。
拌好之後要快速降溫冷藏，它那時是熟食，不是櫥櫃食品。

faq.q: 盒裝填餡料可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃 9～12 個月。若包裝上的日期更短，以包裝為準。
不需要。冰箱潮濕，會讓麵包屑受潮結塊。請放乾燥的櫥櫃。
只要乾爽鬆散、聞起來乾淨，通常還能用，只是香氣變淡。有油耗味、結塊或長霉就丟掉。
